meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑一次视觉核对,用截图确认界面改动是否正常。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都要靠肉眼反复确认有没有走样。
copy.tagline_en: Check any UI change with screenshots and get a clear pass-or-fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep eyeballing every UI change to make sure nothing broke.

howto.what: 每次改完界面，Claude 会截取真实渲染画面（网页、终端、分页 PDF），跑脚本给出差异、溢出、边框错位等数据，再派两个只读审查员复核，最后按页给出通过或返修的结论。
howto.when: 每次构建或改动界面之后、宣布完成之前自动接管；当你问某个页面、组件或 TUI 看起来对不对时也会触发。纯后端、没有渲染输出的改动不适用。

say.text: 帮我给这个页面做视觉 QA，和设计稿对比一下
这个终端界面有没有溢出或边框错位？
say.note: 跑真实终端截图和宽度检查

say.text: 刚才改的那几个页面重新跑一遍视觉检查

howto.what_en: After any UI change, Claude captures real rendered screenshots (web, terminal, paginated PDF), runs scripts for diff, overflow and border data, sends them to two read-only reviewers, and returns a per-page pass or revise verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any UI and before calling it done, or when you ask whether a page, component or TUI looks right. Skipped when there is no rendered surface.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on this page and compare it with the mock
say_en.note: Captures every page and gives a verdict

say_en.text: Does this terminal UI overflow or misalign its borders?
say_en.note: Real pty capture plus width check

say_en.text: Re-run the visual check on the pages I just changed
